answers.reason: The senate decides on university-wide matters and the research associate is not a member of it.
The budget planning round allocates funds and the research associate does not participate there.
The appointment committee selects professors and the research associate does not take part in it.
The faculty council decides on faculty affairs and the research associate's matters are decided elsewhere.
The study commission prepares degree programmes and the research associate does not participate there.
The examination board decides on examination matters and the research associate's matters are not decided here.
The internal research funding round awards small grants for research projects, which is where the research associate's matters are decided.
The module revision working group rewrites module descriptions and the research associate does not take part in it.
The laboratory equipment procurement chooses teaching laboratory equipment and the research associate does not take part in it.
The orientation week planning plans the first week for new students and the research associate does not take part in it.
